title: 3A Side by side Houses, Rooftop Deck, 3mi Broadway
description:
**Please Note: We have Multiple Homes in a row that can accommodate a group of any size.

Conveniently located just 3mi from Broadway and 2mi from Nissan stadium. 

Bed Arrangements:
Bedroom 1) 2 Queens
Bedroom 2) 1 Queen and 2 bunked Twins
Bedroom 3) 1 Queen and 2 bunked Twins
Bedroom 4) 2 Queens
Bedroom 5) 1 Queen and 1 Twin
Bedroom 6) 1 Queen and 1 Twin
All our beds have high quality memory foam mattresses.

The space
We do have multiple houses that can sleep a total of 12+. Please inquire to see if we can fit your group size.

Welcome to Nashville Folks! This new home offers the best experience Nashville has to offer. Relax in the new upgraded kitchen. Relax and check out the Nashville skyline from our new roof deck. This new home has everything you could ask for and more. Granite, Stainless Steel, wood floors, and plenty of sleeping for all of your guests.  The open floor plan gives everyone in your party plenty of space to spread out and enjoy. A 7-10 minute Uber or taxi ride will have you on Broadway.  This is one of the nicest AirBnB properties in all of Nashville and we are certain you will love it. 

The best of the best! This home has it all - plenty of beds and baths for everyone. Large open spaces for gatherings. Rooftop Deck! Close to downtown! This home has it all and we will make sure your stay is a great one!

*Rooftop deck with patio furniture
*Garage for 4 Cars
*Tankless water heater for unlimited showers for your large group
*Wi-Fi Internet
*50" HDTV in Living Room
*High Quality Linens Provided
*Ground floor Master Suite
*Well appointed Kitchen to cook family meals (spices, condiments, and cookware)
*High End Appliances
*Back Patio with Charcoal Grill and Lawn Chairs

Check in time is 3pm. Check out is 10am.

Guest access
Full access to the entire house and front and back yards. Full kitchen and all amenities included. Towels, coffee and other items provided.

When booking with us, you get a list of recommended restaurants, bars, and entertainment. For added security, we offer a 24/7 monitored alarm system.

Other things to note
4 FREE parking spots available. There are only 4 parking spots available at the location. The property cannot hold any more than 4 spots (there is no street parking, only the spots in the back of the house).
